messages.subject: rescale gridster panel(s) for different sizes
parts:
Hi,

I am using gridster to build an app which is going to be viewed in different screen sizes. Right now, gridster asks for a static size for the panels. Thus, I would like to get the screen size:

<script type="text/javascript">
document.write(screen.width+'x'+screen.height);
</script>






and scale my panels accordingly. How do I pass the variable screen.width to Shiny?

Thanks!
